# Shruti 1.4.41
- Shruti is now fully self-contained: the one-click import of settings from another mixer app has been removed from Setup and from the `shruti` command line. Your existing Shruti mix, favourites, effects and exclusions are untouched. - Other audio-routing apps' background engines are still never captured, so Shruti cannot feed its own output back into a loop. - The website and help text no longer refer to other companies' products.
Requires macOS 14.2 or later; Apple silicon and Intel. Existing settings, app arrangements and window preferences are retained.
